name: bug
description: Defect in program logic: code runs but diverges from specification

name: error
description: Wrong artifact or failed execution outside program logic

name: issue
description: Weakness in something existing: unclear, inconsistent, or fragile

name: problem
description: External obstacle blocking progress outside the repo's own code

name: concern
description: Latent risk that has not yet caused harm (security, legal, cost)

name: dilemma
description: Trade-off between valid options depending on owner priorities

name: conflict
description: Two requirements, sources, or rules directly contradict each other

name: gap
description: Missing required file, feature, test, or documentation item

name: hole
description: Missing check or safeguard allowing defects to slip through unnoticed

name: blindspot
description: Unexamined user, platform, assumption, or failure mode
